integrity: An explicit symbolic proof is supported by standalone exhaustive finite multiplication-table checks in 16 constructed examples. This is same-model review only and not an independent mathematical audit. Historical priority may require wider comparison.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite commutative nilpotent semigroups of index d >= 5 and the full power semiring. Does not classify all equality cases. The finite-basis criterion is from Wang–Yin–Wang; the filtration lower bound is also implied by Distler. The sharp all-index witnesses and odd-index nonisomorphic family are the asserted contributions.
title: Sharp minimal witnesses for nonfinite basability of commutative nilpotent power semirings
